rules.label: Financial Assistance - Medically Required Services
rules.quote: We offer financial assistance for services that are medically required.

rules.label: Financial Assistance - Location Restriction
rules.quote: We offer financial assistance only for health care services received at one of our locations.

application.quote: You have up to 240 days after the date of your initial patient responsibility statement to apply.

payment_plan.quote: Start a payment plan arrangement with National Jewish Health. This will help you manage your account while your application is processed.

notes: Eligibility based on insurance coverage, income, family size, assets, and other issues is mentioned but not quantified in the policy text; see Schedule 1 for the Financial Assistance Income and Discount Schedule.

Financial assistance may help pay for co-insurance and deductible amounts but does not apply to co-payment amounts for physician services or any patient balance amounts required by Medicaid or other need-based programs.
Financial assistance is not available when your insurance plan denies access to National Jewish Health.
Application process may require copies of tax returns, bank statements and pay stubs.
When you send in a complete application, you should receive a response within 20 business days.
If you do not make payments and you do not contact us about payments, we may use a collection agency.
We post our FAP in many places to make our patients, families and communities aware of the policy. It is also posted on signs in the admission and registration areas.
rule_fap_general may leave out a condition: Policy requires services to be received at NJH locations and by NJH medical staff.

dropped.claim: A patient with (applied_public_programs) gets an unstated amount of help
dropped.quote: If you qualify for financial assistance, you cannot be charged more than the amounts generally billed.
dropped.why: Quote refers to AGB protection for qualified patients, not a rule granting help based on applied_public_programs.
